title: Cloud & Vendor Spend Creep
subtitle: Cloud costs rose 42% while usage grew only 18%. Where is the waste?
learning_objectives: Use AI to decompose cloud spend into usage-driven vs. waste categories
Detect pricing anomalies, orphaned resources, and commitment gaps
Distinguish growth-driven cost increases from inefficiency
Quantify savings opportunities and prioritise by ease of capture
deliverable: Cloud spend analysis with waste map and 90-day savings plan
